about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for scripts/htc_post_run.sh (rows 458/461/463, the HTC post-run runbook). Run by tests/intent/test_htc_post_run_intent.py against a fake run dir -- never a real gauntlet run, never darktable.
subject: scripts/htc_post_run.sh

examples.why: the ordinary post-run case: the run finished and the runner already exited cleanly, so the script prints the four-step batch for a human to run
a run still in progress must never hand off into merge/push -- this is the guard the whole script exists for
progress.json can say done while the runner process itself has not exited yet (e.g. mid-report); the pid check is the second, independent oracle for that
